adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in handleNewBooking.ts around line 1079, the code sets `destinationCalendar` to `[eventType.destinationCalendar]` or `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]` or `null`. Then later at line 1085, there's `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If both eventType.destinationCalendar and organizerUser.destinationCalendar are null/undefined, evt.destinationCalendar will be null, and the optional chaining `?.push()` will silently do nothing, meaning teamDestinationCalendars (collected cohost calendars for COLLECTIVE events) will be discarded. This is a real bug where collective team members' destination calendars won't be used when the organizer has no destination calendar configured.
